notes.title: Fight Life: Vanguard | Localization Update
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2927700?utm_source=ugf2024&utm_campaign=locupdate

Hello gamers,

We want to announce a list of languages that Fight Life: Vanguard is going to support:
- Ukrainian
- English
- Japanese
- French
- German
- Italian
- Spain
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Traditional Chinese
- Simplified Chinese
- Korean

Happy gaming,
Two Cakes Studio
